kicker: Earnings season meets the macro calendar
title: When CPI and earnings land in the same session, who reads the 10-Q?
sub: I built every US earnings 8-K since 2005 from EDGAR, timed each one to the second, and tested whether the macro calendar changes how the market reads them.
name: Faldo Lyon · November 2026

title: The Fed meets in the middle of earnings season
paras: FOMC statement days carry 126 earnings 8-Ks on average against 72 on an ordinary day. One announcement in seven shares its session with CPI, the jobs report or the Fed.

title: How the test was built
steps: Every 8-K with Item 2.02 from EDGAR; event date is the period of report, time of day from the acceptance stamp.
Crowded means the release lands in the same trading session as CPI, payrolls or the FOMC statement.
Surprise two ways: first-filed GAAP EPS against the same quarter a year earlier, and the two-day market reaction.
Drift over 60 days against FF5 plus momentum, with firm and quarter fixed effects and errors clustered by firm and day.
Hypotheses and thresholds committed before any return was downloaded; 2016–2025 held out and run once.

title: Bad quarters are not hidden behind the Fed
paras: The share of announcements with EPS below last year is the same on crowded and uncrowded sessions in both samples. The regression coefficient is 0.00 (development) and 0.02 (holdout) SUE units, neither distinguishable from zero.

title: Filing on the day went from 57% to 89%
paras: Only 8-Ks filed on the release day carry a usable time of day. 24% of events have none and are excluded from the session test; the share falls every year.

title: Read these before the headline
items: Prices are from Yahoo Finance: half of the events belong to firms since delisted and most of those have no price history. Their crowded share was 14.6% against 15.9% for survivors, so the gap is weakly related to the treatment, and the limits are stated, not solved.
GAAP EPS against last year is not the number analysts trade; consensus data is paid. The market-based surprise runs alongside it.
48 BLS release dates sit in pairs with a revision date; both count as crowded in the primary test and both are dropped in a robustness run.

title: PLACEHOLDER verdict
paras: PLACEHOLDER my read, marked as mine.
Code, data build and pre-registration on GitHub; link in the first comment.

title: Where every number comes from
items: SEC EDGAR submissions and companyfacts (via dated mirrors, four filings checked against live index pages).
FOMC dates: federalreserve.gov; CPI and Employment Situation dates: ALFRED, St. Louis Fed.
Factors: Kenneth French data library, daily FF5 and momentum, September 2026 vintage.
Prices: Yahoo Finance, listed names; delisted coverage measured and reported.
17 unit tests on synthetic EDGAR fixtures; holdout gated behind a committed development result.
